transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

I guess… I’m here because I’ve been having a hard time getting past this feeling that I’ve really failed people. Especially as a father, and just as someone who’s supposed to be useful, I suppose.

It sounds a bit dramatic when I say it out loud, sorry. But it keeps going around in my head, and I start feeling like… maybe I don’t really deserve much of a future.
Have you been having thoughts about ending your life?

I… yes, I have. Not in a way I’m proud of saying.

It’s more like I’ll think it would be easier if I just didn’t wake up. And I know that sounds awful. I haven’t really wanted to worry anyone with it, but… it scared me when I noticed I was going over my finances almost like I was getting things in order for someone else. Does that make sense?
Did these feelings start after a specific stressful event or major change in your life?

I think so, yes. It’s been about a month now… since my daughter left for college out of state.

I don’t want to make it sound like I’m blaming her or that it’s some huge catastrophe—because it’s good for her, obviously. But that’s when this really started feeling harder to shake.
For most of the day, nearly every day over this past month, have you felt depressed or down?
I’m not sure I can say it’s been most of the day every day… I don’t want to overstate it. But I have been feeling pretty low a lot of the time. It kind of hangs around, if that makes sense.
Have you been enjoying things less than you usually do?

Yeah… I think so. I mean, I don’t want to make it sound dramatic, but things I used to really look forward to just don’t feel the same.

I used to spend hours on my model railway, and now the trains are just sitting there half-built on the table. And Cubs games… those were kind of a thing with my daughter. Even turning a game on now feels pointless somehow. Is that the kind of thing you mean?
Have these feelings been making it hard for you to function day to day?

Yeah… I guess it has. I mean, I’m still getting through the basics, mostly, so I don’t want to make it sound worse than it is. But bills are piling up, and there are things around the house I keep meaning to fix or finish, and I just… don’t follow through.

And I’ve kind of stopped seeing people too. I used to have book club, or rides with a couple people I’d count on, and lately I just don’t go.

I’m not sure how to say this without it sounding alarming, but I don’t feel like I can just brush it off anymore. I started organizing my finances like… like someone else might need to understand them, and that scared me a little. Is that the kind of thing you’re asking?
Do these feelings mostly come up when you think about your daughter leaving for college?

Yeah… I mean, I think that’s when it really started. It’s been about a month now, since she left for college out of state.

I don’t know if it’s only when I’m actively thinking about her, exactly, but that was definitely the point where things shifted. Does that answer what you mean?
Even when you’re not thinking about your daughter leaving, do you still feel this low?

I’m not totally sure how to separate it, honestly. I mean, I can be doing something completely ordinary and it’s still sort of… there in the background.

But I don’t know if that’s because I’m thinking about her without realizing it, or if it’s just become the general mood lately. Does that make sense?
When you're not thinking about your daughter leaving, do you still feel down?

I… I think so, yes. Not every single second, maybe, but even when I’m trying to think about other things, it doesn’t really lift the way I’d expect it to.

I don’t want to overstate it, but it feels like it’s just kind of settled in. Is that what you mean?
Before this past month, have you ever had another period in your life when you felt depressed like this?

I don’t think so… not like this, anyway. I mean, I’ve had normal rough patches, like anyone, but I can’t really remember another time where it felt this heavy or lasted like this.

Is that the kind of thing you’re asking?
Have you been feeling especially anxious or on edge lately?

I’m not sure I’d call it anxious, exactly. I mean… I’ve been unsettled, I guess, but I don’t know if that’s the same thing.

I don’t want to make it sound worse than it is. I just feel kind of on edge at times, but I’m not sure how much that stands out compared with everything else. Is that helpful?
Have you been sleeping more or less than usual lately?

Less, I think. I mean, I do get into bed, but then I just… lie there for hours. The house feels so quiet, and I can’t seem to settle.

And then if I do fall asleep, I’ve been waking up around three or four in the morning, and I can’t really get back to sleep. My mind starts going over things I’ve messed up, and it just keeps going.

I don’t know if that’s the kind of sleep problem you mean.
Have you noticed your appetite has changed lately?

A bit, yes. I mean, I wouldn’t say I’m starving myself or anything… I just don’t really bother making proper meals most days.

Sometimes I’ll realize it’s gotten late and I haven’t eaten, and then I’ll just have toast or cereal because that’s easier. I have had to tighten my belt a notch or two, so I suppose I must be eating less than I think. Does that count as an appetite change?
Have you been moving or speaking noticeably slower than usual lately?

I’m not sure, honestly. I haven’t really noticed myself moving slower, but I suppose I’m not paying much attention to that.

Speaking… maybe I’m quieter, or I take longer to answer sometimes, but I don’t know if it would be noticeable to someone else. I don’t want to say yes if that’s not really what you mean.
Have you been having trouble concentrating lately?

Yes… I think so. I don’t want to exaggerate it, but it’s definitely not like I used to be.

I used to handle complicated engineering spreadsheets without really thinking much about it, and now I can sit with something simple, like a grocery list or a bill, for half an hour and still not know what I’m supposed to do next. I keep rereading the same thing and not taking it in.

That is what you mean by trouble concentrating, isn’t it?
Have you been feeling unusually tired or low in energy lately?

Yes… I suppose I have. I mean, I don’t want to make it sound dramatic, but I feel worn out almost all the time.

Even small things, like carrying laundry upstairs or just sorting through the mail, can feel like I’m moving through wet cement. And it doesn’t seem to matter if I’ve been in bed for ages… I still feel like I’ve got no energy. Is that the kind of tiredness you mean?
Have you been feeling worthless lately?

Yes… I think so. I don’t like saying it that plainly, because it sounds a bit self-pitying, but yes.

A lot of what brought me in is that I can’t seem to shake this feeling that I’ve failed — as a father, and just as a useful person, really. It loops around in my head, and I keep thinking I don’t deserve much of a future.

I’m sorry if that sounds extreme. Is that the kind of thing you mean by worthless?
Do these feelings seem much stronger than you would normally expect from your daughter leaving for college?

Yes… I think they probably are. I mean, I know her leaving for college is a big thing, and parents get upset about that, so I’ve been trying to tell myself it’s just that.

But this feels… bigger than missing her. It’s more like I can’t shake the idea that I failed as a father, and as a useful person in general. It keeps looping in my head until I start feeling like I don’t really deserve much of a future.

Sorry — I don’t know if that answers it properly, but yes, it feels stronger than I’d expect.
